known_issues: Published site may show an older version than the latest edits even after refresh/private mode (possible caching or deployment mismatch).
Production publish can fail if chosen domain violates naming rules (5–50 chars; only letters, numbers, hyphens).

existing_features.title: Update the frontend content-loading logic to distinguish between (a) the globally published content (fetched from the backend) and (b) the local draft edits (stored in localStorage). On initial load, fetch published content from the backend and use it as the base content; allow local edits to continue to auto-save as a draft in localStorage.

Add a “Publish” action in the Edit Mode UI that sends the current edited draft content to the backend publish endpoint, then confirms success and updates the app to reflect that the published version is now updated.

Add a small status indicator for editors that communicates whether they are viewing local draft changes vs the currently published version, and provide a one-click way to discard local draft and reload the latest published content.

new_feature_requests.summary: Provide a way to re-publish/force-deploy the latest edited draft so the live site reflects recent edits

Implement backend persistence for the site’s ValentineContent so edits can be published and visible to all visitors (not just the editor’s browser localStorage). Add backend methods to: (1) return the currently published content, and (2) update/overwrite the published content, restricting updates to an authorized admin identity (e.g., the caller principal allowlist).

projectName: Add a true “Publish updated edits” flow so the live site reflects edited photos and letters
